'''Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Limited''' is an [[India|Indian]] [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[pharmaceutical]] company headquartered in [[Ahmedabad]], [[Gujarat]], India. The company is engaged in the manufacturing, marketing and distribution of pharmaceutical products.<ref>{{cite web |title=Top Gujarat companies deliver up to 108% returns since last Diwali |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/top-gujarat-companies-deliver-up-to-108-returns-since-last-diwali/articleshow/105195650.cms |website=The Times of India |date=14 November 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharma gets Gujarat food & drug regulator nod to manufacture COVID-19 drugs |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/pharmaceuticals/lincoln-pharma-gets-gujarat-food-drug-regulator-nod-to-manufacture-covid-19-drugs/articleshow/75406306.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=27 April 2020}}</ref>

Lincoln Pharmaceuticals is listed on [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE) and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE).<ref>{{cite web |title=Stock Share Price- BSE |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/lincoln-pharmaceuticals-ltd/lincoph/531633/ |website=BSE India}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln PharmaCeuticals |url=https://www.nseindia.com/get-quotes/equity?symbol=LINCOLN |website=NSE}}</ref>

==History==
Lincoln Pharmaceuticals was established in 1979 in [[Ahmedabad]], [[Gujarat]] by Mahendra G Patel, Rajnikant G Patel, and Hasmukhbhai I Patel.<ref name="btn">{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Limited: A Healthcare Pioneer with Global Presence |url=https://www.brutimes.com/news/business/lincoln-pharmaceuticals-limited-a-healthcare-pioneer-with-global-presence |website=Bru Times News |language=en}}</ref>

In 1996, the company launched an [[Initial public offering|IPO]] and was listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]]. By 2000, its products were available in 80% of the domestic market across India. In 2010-11 the company launched three NDDS products.<ref name="btn"/>

In collaboration with Phafag AG, Switzerland, Lincoln Pharmaceuticals launched "[[Caroverine|Tinnex Injection]]" in India for [[Tinnitus|Tinnitus disease]]. Tinnitus is commonly known as "bell ringing in the ear".<ref>{{cite web |title=Tinnex injection launched |url=https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/health/medicine-and-research/Tinnex-injection-launched/article14688035.ece |website=The Hindu |language=en-IN |date=18 April 2011}}</ref>

The company was listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] in February 2015.

In September 2016, it introduced an ondansetron oral spray in India to prevent nausea and vomiting caused by chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and surgical procedures.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharma launches Ondansetron oral spray in India - ET HealthWorld {{!}} Pharma |url=https://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/pharma/lincoln-pharma-launches-ondansetron-oral-spray-in-india/54464729 |website=ETHealthworld |language=en}}</ref>

In 2017, The company received a patent for the anti-malarial drug by [[Indian Government]]. This patent is provided for an Arteether injection to treat [[Malaria]] disease.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharma gets patent for anti-malarial drug |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/healthcare/biotech/pharmaceuticals/lincoln-pharma-gets-patent-for-anti-malarial-drug/articleshow/62131792.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=19 December 2017}}</ref>

In May 2020, Linits Khatraj facility received European Union (EU) GMP certification from [[EudraGMP]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharma gets EU GMP nod for Khatraj facility |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/lincoln-pharma-gets-eu-gmp-nod-for-khatraj-facility/article31622884.ece |website=BusinessLine |language=en |date=19 May 2020}}</ref>

In 2021, the company acquired a plant in [[Mehsana]] (Gujarat) to manufacture [[cephalosporin]] products.<ref>{{cite web |title=Soaring high: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals maintains a solid growth trajectory |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/soaring-high-lincoln-pharmaceuticals-maintains-a-solid-growth-trajectory/articleshow/93610390.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=17 August 2022}}</ref>

In September 2021, the [[National Company Law Tribunal]] (NCLT) approved the merger of Lincoln Parenteral with Lincoln Pharmaceuticals.<ref>{{cite web |title=NCLT approves amalgamation of Lincoln Parenteral & Lincoln Pharmaceuticals - ET HealthWorld {{!}} Pharma |url=https://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/pharma/nclt-approves-amalgamation-of-lincoln-parenteral-lincoln-pharmaceuticals/86279989 |website=Economic Times |language=en}}</ref> In October 2021, its Gujarat plant received certification from Australia's [[Therapeutic Goods Administration]] (TGA).<ref>{{cite web |date=8 October 2021 |title=Lincoln Pharma gets Australia's TGA certification for Gujarat plant |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/lincoln-pharma-gets-australias-tga-certification-for-gujarat-plant/article36898794.ece |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}</ref>

==Operations==
Lincoln Pharmaceuticals has two manufacturing facilities in [[Ahmedabad]] and [[Mehsana]] cities of [[Gujarat]] state certified by ISO 9001:2015 and it received WHO cGMP ([[The World Health Organization]] for following [[Good Manufacturing Practices]]) in 1984.<ref name="btn"/>

Lincoln's manufacturing facility is approved by European Union (EU) GMP from [[EudraGMP]], (Therapeutic Goods Administration) TGA - [[Australia]] and over 60 Country's Drug Authorities.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharma launches chewable vitamin C, zinc tablets |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/lincoln-pharma-launches-chewable-vitamin-c-zinc-tablets/article32229753.ece |website=BusinessLine |language=en |date=30 July 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gujarat's pharma industry growth hits 'fever pitch' |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/gujarats-pharma-industry-growth-hits-fever-pitch/articleshow/103338812.cms |website=The Times of India |date=4 September 2023}}</ref>

Lincoln manufactures pharma formulations in various dosage forms like Tablets, Capsules, Dry Syrup, Cream, Non Sterile & Sterile Ointment, Dry Powder Injection, Ampoules Injection, Liquid Vials, Eye Drops, Oral Liquid, etc. Lincoln Pharma has a diversified portfolio with 1,700 plus product registrations, registered products in the above markets, and another 700 products in the pipeline.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Limited Report |url=https://bsmedia.business-standard.com/_media/bs/data/announcements/bse/06092024/c67fda9c-8077-4df4-91a4-7af9d3972996.pdf |website=Business Standard}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Ltd achieves the milestone of Profit Growth Every Single year from FY13 to FY23 |url=https://www.ahmedabadmirror.com/lincoln-pharmaceuticals-ltd-achieves-the-milestone-of-profit-growth-every-single-year-from-fy13-to-fy23/81861095.html |website=Ahmedabad Mirror |language=en}}</ref>
